**Class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package. Inherits from [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/).

```csharp
public sealed class PrintAuthenticationException : PrintException
```

The exception thrown when a print system needs a user name and password for a request, or doesn't accept the ones it was given.

Catch it to ask the user for credentials, then create the print system again with them; for CUPS, through `CupsOptions.Credentials`. [PrintException.NativeErrorCode](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/#nativeerrorcode) holds the HTTP or IPP status the print system answered with, such as 401.
